description: PropertyStoreDataBlock carrying System.AppUserModel.ID and three siblings
notes: MS-PROPSTORE 2.2 storage with format ID {9F4C2855-9F79-4B39-A8D0-E1D42DE1D5F3}; property 5 is the AppUserModelID 'Microsoft.Windows.Explorer' as VT_LPWSTR. Version is 0x53505331 ('1SPS' on the wire). UnicodeString Length counts characters including the terminator, not bytes.
leak_allow_reason: The UUID in the notes is PKEY_AppUserModel_ID's published format ID, documented by Microsoft and identical everywhere. It names a property set, not an install.
